mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in over 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers a market reassessment of corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand surge that increases inflation expectations and triggers a preemptive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 730000.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals entrenched inflation, prompting market expectations of prolonged restrictive policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 4.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a labor market overheating that accelerates wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption expenditures above 730,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production, signals robust aggregate demand that increases inflationary pressure and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 730000.0 and INDPRO > 100.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
